purpose: Teach: 大尉/同書/号証/線形/密集/細心/デモンストレーション/もとづく
target_vocab: デモンストレーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、軍事史で大尉の役割を学ぶといい
lines.en: Ren — you should study the captain's role in military history.
lines.style: Measured, quiet authority. Leans forward slightly. Not commanding, but instructing with the weight of experience behind it. Deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文では同書の参考箇所を明示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the references from that source are clearly marked in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Sits up straighter. Genuine commitment in the voice — not just compliance, but taking ownership of the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、訴訟資料の号証管理を覚えろ
lines.en: Ren — you need to learn how to manage exhibit numbers in legal documents.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. Light emphasis on 「manage」. Still warm beneath the instruction, but this one matters practically. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データの線形回帰を試みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on applying linear regression to the data.
lines.style: Rapid, slightly breathless — eager to prove he's listening and acting. A touch uncertain beneath the politeness, wanting to get it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、密集した学会会場でも発表は冷静にしろ
lines.en: Ren — even in a crowded conference, keep your presentation calm.
lines.style: Warm but firm. Not sharp — protective almost. The voice of someone who knows what it feels like to lose composure in front of an audience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験は細心の注意で進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move through the experiment with careful attention to detail.
lines.style: Respectful, methodical. Slower pace. Ren is listening deeply here, internalising the advice. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会発表でデモンストレーションを工夫しろ
lines.en: Ren — think carefully about how you'll demonstrate your work at the conference.
lines.style: Encouraging but exacting. Not criticism — invitation to think harder. The tone of a mentor who believes the student can do better.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。結論は実験データにもとづく姿勢を貫きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll stand by my findings and let the experimental data drive my conclusions.
lines.style: Firm and quiet. This is his commitment crystallising. Each phrase deliberate. A small breath before the final thought — conviction settling into place.
